## Biography

Collinder 70 sits adjacent to the Orion region — a sector John Ermitage wanted monitored during the Distant Worlds 3 expedition. The Pilots Federation asked Deep Space Surveys to investigate missing ships there. Cal called it "the Umbra Sagittarii," the Archer's Shadow, a region explorers once considered cursed.

What makes Collinder 70 significant is not what is known but what is suspected. The missing Universal Cartographics cruiser. The failed Alliance expedition led by Hieronymus Halsey. The frequency of ships vanishing without trace. Ermitage chose Orion as the DW3 destination partly because it allowed the fleet to keep "watchful eyes" on this adjacent sector. Whether the watchfulness revealed anything beyond more questions, the expedition records do not say. Some surveillance yields intelligence. Some yields only deeper unease.
